ingOpt: Almonds, walnuts or other seeds, crushed

insSteps: Cut the squash into big dices. Cook it in salted boiling water until soft.
Let the squash pieces rest in a colander for 30 minutes for the extra water to drain.
In a bowl, crush and mix the squash with the eggs, milk, nutritional yeast flakes and half of the cheese. Add salt, pepper and nutmeg to taste, mix well.
Pour the mixture in a baking dish. Top with the rest of the cheese and crushed nuts.
